Syllabus

CIS 2400, Fall 2026. Introduction to Computer Systems II.

Grading

  • Projects: 60%
  • Midterm: 15%
  • Final: 20%
  • Participation: 5%

Late Policy

Each student has 5 late days for the semester, usable in whole-day increments on any project. After late days are exhausted, submissions lose 10% per day late, and nothing is accepted more than 3 days after the deadline without a documented excuse.

Regrade Requests

Regrade requests must be submitted through Gradescope within 7 days of grades being posted.
